description: Third-party components of the ARCILOGGER Windows bundle. A sha256 is only recorded here when it was computed from a file actually downloaded (and, where the vendor publishes one, compared with the vendor's checksum file). null means: not verified; Build-ArciBundle.ps1 refuses the component unless the operator passes a checksum checked on the vendor site (-ComponentSha256). licence_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the licence text at licence_url (a tag-pinned file, computed from the downloaded text on the date in verified_on, or on 2026-10-12 for the licence texts); Build-ArciBundle.ps1 copies the verified texts into the bundle's licenses folder.

roles.bundled: Downloaded by Build-ArciBundle.ps1, verified, shipped in the bundle and installed by Install-Arcilogger.ps1.
roles.operator: Installed by the operator with the vendor's own installer. Copied into the bundle's operator-installers folder for offline use only when a verified checksum is known; ARCILOGGER only configures it.

components.name: python
components.title: Python 3.12 runtime for Windows x64 (python-build-standalone, install_only)
components.licence: PSF-2.0 (CPython) with the third-party notices in python/LICENSE.txt (OpenSSL Apache-2.0, libffi MIT, zlib, bzip2, xz, SQLite public domain, Tcl/Tk BSD-style); build scripts MPL-2.0
components.sha256_source: Computed from the downloaded file; identical to the line for this file in the vendor's SHA256SUMS release asset.
components.notes: Chosen over the python.org installer: a relocatable archive (top folder python/) that needs no MSI, no registry entries and no internet, contains pip (ensurepip) and venv, and is the build uv itself uses. python.org could not be reached from the build environment for verification.

components.name: winsw
components.title: WinSW Windows service wrapper, .NET Framework 4.6.1 build
components.sha256_source: Computed from the downloaded file (the vendor publishes no checksum file). Embedded file version 2.12.0.0, target framework .NETFramework v4.6.1.
components.notes: WinSW-x64.exe of the same release embeds its own .NET 6.0.13 runtime (out of support since 2024-11, never patched by Windows Update). WinSW.NET461.exe runs on the .NET Framework 4.8 that ships with Windows Server 2022/2025 and Windows 11 and is serviced by Windows Update. XML options used are only those documented in doc/xmlConfigFile.md and doc/loggingAndErrorReporting.md of v2.12.0.

components.name: caddy
components.title: Caddy web server for Windows amd64
components.sha256_source: Computed from the downloaded file. The vendor publishes SHA-512 only: the file's SHA-512 equals the entry in caddy_2.11.7_checksums.txt (recorded in vendor_sha512).
components.notes: Zip contains caddy.exe, LICENSE and README.md (built 2026-10-03). deploy/windows/caddy/Caddyfile is validated with this version (caddy adapt) in the installer tests.

components.name: temurin8-jre
components.title: Eclipse Temurin 8 JRE for Windows x64 (MSI), for the Kamu SM Zamane console client
components.licence: GPL-2.0-only WITH Classpath-exception-2.0 (OpenJDK); a separate program that ARCILOGGER only starts, never links or modifies
components.sha256_source: Computed from the downloaded file; identical to the vendor's OpenJDK8U-jre_x64_windows_hotspot_8u502b07.msi.sha256.txt release asset.
components.notes: The MSI's default folder is 'C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium\jre-8.0.502.7-hotspot\' (MSI Directory table). docs/KURULUM.md installs it with INSTALLDIR set to 'C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium\jre-8\' so the path in arcilogger.example.toml stays valid across Java updates. Only needed for tsa.provider = "zamane".

components.name: zamane
components.title: Kamu SM Zamane console client (tss-client-console-3.1.33.jar)
components.licence: Kamu SM (TÜBİTAK BİLGEM) free client licence (License_62_GENEL_ZD_ISTEMCI.zip); not redistributed by ARCILOGGER
components.sha256_source: Not downloaded here. The administrator downloads it from Kamu SM; Install-Arcilogger.ps1 -ZamaneJar shows its SHA-256 and compares it with the value published on the Kamu SM page (-ZamaneJarSha256 or an interactive confirmation), then records it in C:\ProgramData\ARCILOGGER\zamane\zamane-jar.sha256.
components.notes: Never committed and never put into the bundle.

components.name: postgresql
components.title: PostgreSQL 16 for Windows x64 (EDB installer)
components.sha256_source: Not verified: enterprisedb.com and postgresql.org could not be reached from the build environment on 2026-10-12. Download the installer from the EDB page linked from https://www.postgresql.org/download/windows/; Build-ArciBundle.ps1 copies it into the bundle only with -ComponentUrl and -ComponentSha256 given by the operator.
components.notes: Install-Arcilogger.ps1 stops with Turkish instructions when no PostgreSQL service (postgresql-x64-16) is present. ARCILOGGER creates its own role and database; the postgres superuser password is asked once and never stored.

components.name: timescaledb
components.title: TimescaleDB for PostgreSQL 16, Windows amd64 build (optional)
components.licence: Apache-2.0 for timescaledb-2.30.2.dll; Timescale License (TSL, source-available, not OSI-approved) for timescaledb-tsl-2.30.2.dll (compression, retention policies). Owner decision needed before use; with timescaledb.license = 'apache' only the Apache-2.0 part is loaded.
components.sha256_source: Computed from the downloaded file (no vendor checksum file is published with the release).
components.notes: An official Windows build for PostgreSQL 16 exists for 2.30.2 (zip with setup.exe, built 2026-09-29). Optional: ARCILOGGER runs on plain PostgreSQL 16. Verify on site that setup.exe accepts the installed PostgreSQL 16 minor version.
